review.posthog_relevance: Adds workflows to the billing and token-cap configuration alongside existing products, and includes tests for this billing behavior.
review.reason: The observed change P1.F4.H6 adds 'workflows' to the set of products billed against AI credits and updates related configuration and tests. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement: it establishes workflows as a billable entity and updates the relevant checks and assertions. While the implementation and relevant checks are visible, the tier is not raised to 3,

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the workflows product, the AI gateway token minting, or the credit lookup. It only adds configuration and tests. No score is assigned.
